notes.subject: שרי
notes.rationale: Crux: šar ke 'dikgoši/diatokelo'; ditlhahuiso dingwe di akaretša 'setšhaba' bjalo ka sehlantšhi sa dikgoši, tše dingwe di di arogantša.

notes.subject: ba re motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe go mošuwa wa gagwe
notes.rationale: Puo ye e lebisa kgošing ya motho ka noši, go dumelelana magareng ga dikgoši tša Gileada.

notes.subject: Ke mang motho yoo...
notes.rationale: Potšišo yeo e laletšago motho wa go thoma ntwa — sebaka se bulelwago se tsenelwa ke Yiftakhe ka molao wa 11.

notes.subject: יחל
notes.rationale: חלל e bolela ka nnete 'go bula/lehwa', fela ka mo go tlwaelegilego 'go thoma'; 'go thoma' e šomišitšwe go boloka ponagatšo ya go hlahlama ntwa.

translation: Gomme setšhaba, dikgoši tša Gileada, ba re motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe go mošuwa wa gagwe: Ke mang ⟨אשר⟩ motho yoo a ka thomago go lwantšha bana ba Ammo? Yoo o tla ba hlogo ya batho bohle ba ba dulago Gileada.

tokens.gloss: motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe
